dz: 明中宗永乐皇帝对蒙古人发动了第一次军事攻势,使蒙古可汗布尼亚希里倒台.
de: The Yongle Emperor of Ming China launches the first of his military campaigns against the Mongols, resulting in the fall of the Mongol khan Bunyashiri.

dz: 在奥农河的一次决定性战役中,奥尔吉特穆尔的蒙古军队被永乐皇帝的中国军队所歼灭.
de: In a decisive battle at Onon River, the Mongol forces of Oljei Temur were decimated by the Chinese armies of the Yongle Emperor.

de: Ottoman Interregnum: Süleyman Çelebi defeats his brother Musa Çelebi outside the Byzantine capital, Constantinople.
